record.bible_text: When I would have healed<WH07495><WTH8800> Israel<WH03478>, then the iniquity<WH05771> of Ephraim<WH0669> was discovered<WH01540><WTH8738>, and the wickedness<WH07451> of Samaria<WH08111>: for they commit<WH06466><WTH8804> falsehood<WH08267>; and the thief<WH01590> cometh in<WH0935><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> the troop<WH01416> of robbers spoileth<WH06584><WTH8804> without<WH02351>. <RF>wickedness: Heb. evils<Rf> <RF>spoileth: Heb. strippeth<Rf>

And they consider<WH0559><WTH8799> not in their hearts<WH03824> <FI>that<Fi> I remember<WH02142><WTH8804> all their wickedness<WH07451>: now their own doings<WH04611> have beset them about<WH05437><WTH8804>; they are before my face<WH06440>. <RF>consider...: Heb. say not to<Rf>
They make the king<WH04428> glad<WH08055><WTH8762> with their wickedness<WH07451>, and the princes<WH08269> with their lies<WH03585>.

They <FI>are<Fi> all adulterers<WH05003><WTH8764>, as an oven<WH08574> heated<WH01197><WTH8802> by the baker<WH0644><WTH8802>, <FI>who<Fi> ceaseth<WH07673><WTH8799> from raising<WH05782><WTH8800> after he hath kneaded<WH03888><WTH8800> the dough<WH01217>, until it be leavened<WH02556><WTH8800>. <RF>who...: or, the raiser will cease<Rf> <RF>raising: or, waking<Rf>

In the day<WH03117> of our king<WH04428> the princes<WH08269> have made <FI>him<Fi> sick<WH02470><WTH8689> with bottles<WH02534> of wine<WH03196>; he stretched out<WH04900><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> with scorners<WH03945><WTH8802>. <RF>bottles...: or, heat through wine<Rf>

For they have made ready<WH07126><WTH8765> their heart<WH03820> like an oven<WH08574>, whiles they lie in wait<WH0693><WTH8800>: their baker<WH0644><WTH8802> sleepeth<WH03463> all the night<WH03915>; in the morning<WH01242> it burneth<WH01197><WTH8802> as a flaming<WH03852> fire<WH0784>. <RF>made...: or, applied<Rf>

They are all hot<WH02552><WTH8735> as an oven<WH08574>, and have devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> their judges<WH08199><WTH8802>; all their kings<WH04428> are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>: <FI>there is<Fi> none among them that calleth<WH07121><WTH8802> unto me.<CM>
Ephraim<WH0669>, he hath mixed<WH01101><WTH8704> himself among the people<WH05971>; Ephraim<WH0669> is a cake<WH05692> not turned<WH02015><WTH8803>.

Strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> have devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> his strength<WH03581>, and he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> not: yea, gray hairs<WH07872> are here and there<WH02236><WTH8804> upon him, yet he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> not. <RF>here...: Heb. sprinkled<Rf>

And the pride<WH01347> of Israel<WH03478> testifieth<WH06030><WTH8804> to his face<WH06440>: and they do not return<WH07725><WTH8804> to the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, nor seek<WH01245><WTH8765> him for all this.
Ephraim<WH0669> also is like a silly<WH06601><WTH8802> dove<WH03123> without heart<WH03820>: they call<WH07121><WTH8804> to Egypt<WH04714>, they go<WH01980><WTH8804> to Assyria<WH0804>.

When they shall go<WH03212><WTH8799>, I will spread<WH06566><WTH8799> my net<WH07568> upon them; I will bring them down<WH03381><WTH8686> as the fowls<WH05775> of the heaven<WH08064>; I will chastise<WH03256><WTH8686> them, as their congregation<WH05712> hath heard<WH08088>.

Woe<WH0188> unto them! for they have fled<WH05074><WTH8804> from me: destruction<WH07701> unto them! because they have transgressed<WH06586><WTH8804> against me: though I have redeemed<WH06299><WTH8799> them, yet they have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> lies<WH03577> against me. <RF>destruction: Heb. spoil<Rf>

And they have not cried<WH02199><WTH8804> unto me with their heart<WH03820>, when they howled<WH03213><WTH8686> upon their beds<WH04904>: they assemble<WH01481><WTH8709> themselves for corn<WH01715> and wine<WH08492>, <FI>and<Fi> they rebel<WH05493><WTH8799> against me.

Though I have bound<WH03256><WTH8765> <FI>and<Fi> strengthened<WH02388><WTH8765> their arms<WH02220>, yet do they imagine<WH02803><WTH8762> mischief<WH07451> against me. <RF>have...: or, chastened<Rf>

They return<WH07725><WTH8799>, <FI>but<Fi> not to the most High<WH05920>: they are like a deceitful<WH07423> bow<WH07198>: their princes<WH08269> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719> for the rage<WH02195> of their tongue<WH03956>: this<WH02097> <FI>shall be<Fi> their derision<WH03933> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.<CM>
